content:
Every dog story carries a heartbeat of unwavering devotion, and Bentley's journey is no exception.

Bentley Wandered Down a Steep Idaho Hillside—Then the Ground Gave Way Beneath Her 🐶❤️ On the evening of July 22, 2026, an elderly dog named Bentley wandered down a steep hillside in Swan Valley, Idaho.

The slope was covered in loose rock.

Bentley became trapped waist-deep in the unstable slide, unable to work her way back up.

Just before 7 p.

m., the Swan Valley Fire Department and Bonneville County Sheriff’s Office were called to help.

Five first responders carefully made their way across the steep gravel hillside.

Photos released by the fire department showed crew members balancing on the loose terrain while gently comforting Bentley and digging around her to free her.

Once she was loose, rescuers secured Bentley and hoisted her back up the hillside.

At the top, her owner was waiting.

A quiet evening walk had turned into a rescue involving firefighters, deputies, ropes and five people willing to climb down after one nervous senior dog.

Sometimes getting older means needing a little more help finding your way home.

Today, Bentley stands as a testament to the enduring bond between dogs and the families who cherish them.

content:
Every dog story carries a heartbeat of unwavering devotion, and Prieta's journey is no exception.

Missing for Weeks, Prieta Was Found Half a Mile Out in San Francisco Bay 🐶🌊 A small dog named Prieta had been missing since the Fourth of July weekend in 2026 when someone called 911 on July 16 after seeing a dog enter San Francisco Bay near the Dumbarton Bridge in East Palo Alto, California.

Menlo Park Fire Protection District crews responded with two trucks, a boat, an airboat and a drone.

Rescuers first tracked the dog from shore with binoculars before following her out onto the water.

Prieta kept swimming farther into the bay.

She was eventually located about half a mile from shore.

Firefighters reached her, pulled her from the water and wrapped the exhausted little dog in towels.

Police officers also assisted during the operation.

Prieta was then taken to a local SPCA.

The best news came afterward: staff located her family, and the dog who had been missing for weeks finally went home.

She had already been lost for weeks.

Then somehow, she found herself swimming farther and farther from land.

Today, Prieta stands as a testament to the enduring bond between dogs and the families who cherish them.
